author: Hannah Fry
description:
Some people like to go to beaches. 
Others like to go geek out over big metal boxes. 
Whatever floats your boat! 🚢 
(Especially if that boat is a massive container ship)

The one to read: Estimating the effects of the container revolution on world trade, by D Bernhofen, Z El-Sahli, and R Kneller (2016)
title: The box that built the modern world
